instruction.text: This formula is used to estimate the height in centimetres of young children. Kareem’s brother is 5 years of age. Use the formula to estimate his height.
Kareem’s sister is 120 centimetres tall. Use the formula to estimate her age.
This formula is used to calculate the cost in pounds of running a small tournament. Use the formula to estimate how much it costs to run a tournament with 10 players.
Estimate the number of players that played at a tournament that cost £180 to run.
This formula is used to estimate time in hours spent on hobbies. How much time has Sarah spent on hobbies after 5 days?
Abdul has spent 34 hours on hobbies. Estimate the number of days this took him.
Lisa is a gardener. She came up with this formula to estimate her weekly water usage in litres. How much water does she use if she has 6 plants?
Anne is another gardener. She used 118 litres of water in a week. Using Lisa’s formula, estimate the number of plants she cares for.
